cohort: 939 healthy term infants born to mothers of Caucasian origin
finding: Cord blood 25(OH)D levels at birth were positively correlated with MMP-8 and hs-CRP concentrations, suggesting a potential role for vitamin D in modulating the neonatal innate immune response.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was adjusted for as a potential confounder in the analysis of 25(OH)D and inflammatory markers.
